Hanna —

Thanks — great to hear HealthNexus is moving this forward. I put together three concise commercial paths and attached a spreadsheet with line-item estimates (Redwood_Private_Pricing_Options_v1.xlsx). High level: 

Option A — Pilot (3–6 nodes):
- One-time: migration/setup (includes deployment automation + 2 weeks onsite/remote runbook) — $45k
- Recurring: platform fee (annualized) — $60k/year
- Nodes: metered per-node fee (GPU-based) — $6k/node/month (3-node baseline)
- Optional SRE retainer: $12k/month (for 24/7 on-call and runbook management)

Option B — Mid (9–12 nodes, preferred for production):
- One-time: migration/setup — $30k (we amortize for larger commits)
- Recurring: platform fee — $120k/year (discounted band)
- Nodes: $5.1k/node/month at 12-node band
- Optional SRE retainer: $10k/month

Option C — Consumption-anchored (metered with commit):
- Lower platform fee (starts $40k/year) and deeper node discounts as commit grows
- Migration credit: up to 25% of one-time fees applied for 12+ month commitments

Pilot credit note: for short pilots (<=9 months) we can offer a one-time onboarding credit of up to 20% off one-time setup (case-by-case), plus a one-time $15k migration assistance credit if you commit to a 12-month renewal.

Support tiers (summary):
- Business: 8x5 support, 4‑hour P1 response, standard console access
- Enterprise: 24x7 support, 1‑hour P1 response, monthly reviews, audit logs retention (30d)
- SRE retainer: dedicated engineering hours, runbook ops, incident simulations, 99.95% target during covered windows

I attached the SOW template and SOC2 quick guide for your security team. If you can share an expected node profile (GPU type, avg seq len, QPS), I can produce a tighter cost model that fits the $400k first‑year target.

Best,
Aditya Rao
